entry.tone: Warm, grounding, low-pressure. The user just arrived. Don't push.
prompts: What does your body feel like right now? Not your mind. Your body.
If today had a color, what would it be?
What's one small thing you did for yourself today?
What sound would describe your week so far?

sensory.tone: Go deeper. Invite vulnerability. Start connecting feelings to patterns.
prompts: What's something you've been avoiding thinking about?
When was the last time you felt fully present? What were you doing?
What would you say to yourself from five years ago?
What emotion do you feel most often but rarely name out loud?
Describe a moment this week that surprised you, even slightly.

agency.tone: Shadow territory. Honest confrontation. Most people want to quit here. The prompts acknowledge that.
prompts: What story do you keep telling yourself that might not be true?
What are you holding onto that no longer serves you?
If you could change one pattern in your life tomorrow, what would it be?
This is the hard part. Most people stop here. Why are you still here?
What would your life look like if you weren't afraid?

reflection.tone: Meaning-making. Connecting dots. The user starts seeing their own arc.
prompts: Read your first journal entry. What do you notice about that person?
What has shifted since you started? It can be small.
Who in your life would notice the change you're making?
What would you tell someone just starting this journey?

proof.tone: The user claims their transformation. Agency. Choice. Self-authorship.
prompts: Write one sentence about who you are becoming.
What will you carry forward from these {days} days?
You've been here {days} days. You chose this every single time. What does that tell you about yourself?

patternOverrides.sameMood4Days: You've been feeling {mood} for several days. What does this state need from you?
patternOverrides.shiftedHeavyToLight: Something shifted. Can you name what changed?
patternOverrides.highRitualLowMood: You're showing up for your rituals even when it's hard. What keeps you going?
patternOverrides.lowRitualGoodMood: You've been feeling good without your rituals. What's carrying you?
patternOverrides.newPhase: You've entered {phase}. What does this feel like?
patternOverrides.weekStreak: A week of consistency. What's different about this time?
patternOverrides.noJournal3Days: It's been a few days since you wrote. Is there something waiting to be said?
